Who we are

About AlgoZenith

AlgoZenith is a student community focused on building strong problem-solving fundamentals through daily practice, peer discussion, and friendly competition — not one-off events.

▲

Learn

Structured daily challenges that build core data structures and algorithms knowledge, one problem at a time.

◆

Practice

Streaks, leaderboards, and a discussion board where you can compare approaches with other members.

●

Compete

Contests and events that put your skills to the test against the rest of the community.

Mission

To make consistent, daily problem-solving practice the norm — not the exception — for every member.

Vision

To build a community where students hold each other accountable and grow into strong, confident problem solvers together.
